description: This file defines the `VcapServicesStringSupplier` class, which reads a configuration file specified either by an environment variable or directly via a static factory method. The class provides functionality to obtain the contents of the specified config file as a string wrapped in an Optional, throwing errors if the file cannot be read or is invalid.

classes.name: VcapServicesStringSupplier
classes.description: Immutable class that provides a supplier for reading the contents of a configurable VCAP services file, either via environment variable or explicit path.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance using the environment variable `VCAP_LOCATION` to find the config file path.

methods.name: tryToGetAsPath
methods.description: Attempts to convert a string path from environment variable to a Path object, throwing a custom error on failure.

methods.name: getAsPath
methods.description: Converts a string to a Path, throwing an exception if the string is not a valid path.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance from a given Path.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the config file content as a string, or empty if the file is empty.

methods.name: tryToReadConfigFile
methods.description: Attempts to read the config file content, logs errors, and throws a `DittoConfigError` if reading fails.

methods.name: readConfigFile
methods.description: Reads all bytes from the config file and returns the content as a string, or null if empty.
